name: Plagueland Survivalist shortens disease durations on you by 30% (#1103)
contract: Plagueland Survivalist 681169 (installed Spell.dbc) is a passive family-21 spell with one effect: SPELL_AURA_MOD_AURA_DURATION_BY_DISPEL (245), misc 3 = DISPEL_DISEASE, base -31 die 1 -> -30; the Description reads 'Reduces the duration of disease effects on you by 30%.' Unit::ModSpellDuration adds GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscValue(SPELL_AURA_MOD_AURA_DURATION_BY_DISPEL, Dispel) for harmful auras on the cast path (Spell.cpp DoSpellHitOnUnit); the set_aura fixture bypasses it, so a real cast is needed. Ghoul Rot 83985 is a Spell.dbc entry with Dispel = 3 (disease), SPELL_ATTR0_AURA_IS_DEBUFF, a self target (effect 0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HIT_CHANCE, base -11 die 1) and duration index 6 = 600000 ms, so a fixture player that knows it can cast it on itself. The holder's aura must last 0.70 of the control's (0.69-0.71 absorbs the few milliseconds between the two casts). The spell is chosen only as a harmless carrier with the right dispel type; it is not a Witch Hunter spell.
